pages.text: The creative items of other mods (infinite chests, tanks, energy cells...) are no longer simply handed out by the Core, nor kept in the Transcendental's reliquaries - those now hold the controllers of the great machines of the endgame.$(br2)Only the rebuilt Core's $(thing)FORGE$() can make creative items, each from Eschaton Cores, Omnipotent Ingots, Absolute Singularities and Transcendence Crystals - and each needs its own universe tuned.

Pack makers: the Forge finds creative items by itself (a list of known ones, and any item whose id says "creative"). The item tag $(thing)theoreticalsciences:forge_only$() adds items the search misses - or late-endgame items to keep behind the Forge - and $(thing)theoreticalsciences:forge_exempt$() takes out ones it picked up by mistake.
